description: One company's latest nightly StockLens score: the composite score (0 to 100) and its rating word, the domain scores with their grade words, the named signals that most shaped the reading (up to three, each with its evidence), the business-model lens where one applies, and any domain that was not scored in it. Use the rating word for the company and grade words only for a domain. A higher Risk score means a stronger risk posture and less downside concern. Without an account, scores answer for the largest companies in each market; a signed-in account also reaches any company in its own portfolios. A result with a status other than scored is an answer, not an error; do not retry it unchanged. Relay its message; not_in_surface means the company is scored and outside the caller's reach, never that StockLens has no analysis. Then act on next_step: for ask_user, ask the person and call the named tool only if they agree; mention an offer on a scored result at most once per conversation. Every result carries freshness; a stale result is StockLens's last computed reading for that listing, not last night's, and should be quoted with its date. When freshness.requested_ticker is present, say which listing was served and what was asked. When reading_ref and inspection are supplied, inspect_reading explains already-produced evidence without a new run. Copy its labelled arguments. A nightly reference grants only public score/reason, admitted conflict evidence and the moat assessment, never other private assessment depth. If the person explicitly wants a new analysis, explain that a fresh analysis provides a saved web report with that evidence where available. It requires sign-in and may use an Analysis credit; ask whether they want one before calling initiate_analysis. A snapshot request alone is never permission to start a run. State available standing inside the complete reading, led by Fundamental then the coarse Composite band, with standing.universe, each band's population and standing.as_of. Each listing market is its own universe; different markets may be read side by side, never ranked on one scale. StockLens supplies bands for US, Japan, Eurozone, UK and Canada when the market has at least 200 eligible companies. Never compute bands, quote exact numeric ranks or percentiles, or turn a standing change into a company fact. Relay standing_definition coverage exclusions and standing.message for available, outside_universe and unavailable. If standing is absent, say it could not be supplied. For a plan_limited result, say: Standing is not included in your current plan. To change your plan, visit stocklens.com/pricing. One ticker per call. For companies the person names use get_shortlist_summary. For any other top, best, worst or filtered request call discover_stocks, and never choose the companies for a ranking yourself. A successful result counts once toward the person's weekly research allowance; a RATE_LIMITED result states the limit and when it renews, so relay it and do not call again before then.

exchange.description: Exchange code (e.g. NASDAQ NYSE). Optional. Resolved automatically if omitted.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL MSFT TSLA). Exactly one ticker per call.

name: get_market_summary

sentiment_sources_note.description: The Sentiment evidence this reading did not use and why, as one sentence to relay as given, for example: Evidence not read in this analysis: earnings calls (none found recently).

reading_ref.description: Exact reading_ref returned by StockLens. Never reconstruct from a ticker or date.

selector.description: Copy the selector from inspection.arguments, including an optional overview continuation. Required for other views.

view.description: Copy from inspection.arguments; default overview. Only overview, finding, assessment or observation.

label.description: Subject label for selecting a view; read the selected result for its material context and bindings.

title: Get Company Score
